LANDED. Change 1703 merged as 83d91d488c (Gerrit rebased on submit, so the landed sha differs from the pushed 317ba959c0; same tree). Gates: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted via POST /a/changes/1703/submit as RebarBotNava.

All three ACs re-verified against the MERGED tree, not just the pre-push worktree:
- AC1: `mypy src/rebar/attest --disallow-untyped-defs` -> Success, no issues in 7 source files.
- AC2: Any-count grep reports exactly 2 (unchanged registry.py trust_root boundary) — no widening was used to satisfy the check.
- AC3: `git diff ae6f2ac57a..HEAD --stat -- pyproject.toml` is empty; the only attest file in the range is authorship.py (+24/-15). (The range also shows doctor_locks/doctor files from a sibling change that landed in between — unrelated to this ticket.)

The pyproject ratchet flip stays deferred to 06e0-fb68-657a-4ea1, now unblocked on the attest side: the package is disallow_untyped_defs-clean, so that promotion is a one-line change whenever pyproject.toml contention clears.

Follow-up filed: courageous-deserving-manatee (760f-608f-4c69-449a), linked discovered_from — authorship.py is now 793/800 LOC, 7 lines under the module-size cap, because the annotations forced ruff to wrap four signatures.
